description: This Java class 'SimpleWikiHelper' provides utility methods for interacting with the Wiktionary API, including fetching page content and handling HTTP requests and JSON parsing.

classes.name: SimpleWikiHelper
classes.description: A helper class for making API requests to Wiktionary, parsing responses, and managing HTTP connections with custom User-Agent handling.

classes.name: SimpleWikiHelper.ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when there are network or server errors during API communication.

classes.name: SimpleWikiHelper.ParseException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when there are errors parsing the API's JSON responses.

methods.name: prepareUserAgent
methods.description: Initializes the User-Agent string based on application's package name and version number.

methods.name: getPageContent
methods.description: Fetches the content of a specified Wiktionary page by making an API call, with an option to expand templates.

methods.name: getUrlContent
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URL and returns the response content as a string.
